{{Quote|This is Ebaq, a gas giant with eleven moons. Of these, Ebaq Nine was once exploited by the Deep Core Mining Corporation for its deposits of bronzium.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]|<ref name="DW" />}}
'''Ebaq''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Treskov system]] and the fifth planet of that system, orbiting [[Treskov 115-W]]. The planet had eleven moons, including [[Ebaq 9]].<ref name="DW" />
